decisionsTitle: A shop price has a currency: lei or euro, never converted
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10**, back from holiday with the supplier's sheet in hand: the club's t-shirts, long-sleeve shirts and buffs are priced by the supplier in euro, and the members' shop must show those prices in EUR, as EUR. Asked «what do members pay?» he chose «EUR, shown as EUR» over a lei price the club sets.

**Decision.** A shop price has a currency, lei or euro, chosen per product in the editor («Moneda», a native select beside the price box: «lei (RON)» / «euro (EUR)», lei unless the club chooses otherwise — absent from the post, as from an older form or a script, the product is in lei). It is shown in that currency everywhere the member or the club reads it — the zone's shop and «Comenzile mele», the editor's list, the orders list, the CSV and the three emails — and never converted: in lei «45 lei» / «45,50 lei» (ro) and «45.50 lei» (en), as before, byte for byte; in euro «30 €» / «30,25 €» (ro, a no-break space before the sign) and «€30» / «€30.25» (en), the whole part grouped the locale's way. One function formats a shop price (`content/shop/domain.ts#formatPrice`) and it is the one place a currency symbol is written; the editor's box reads «45», «45,50», «45.50» and drops a trailing «lei», «€», «eur» or «euro» whatever it says — the currency is the select's, not the box's — and refuses any other word (`parsePriceToMinor`). **An order keeps the currency it was placed in** as it keeps its unit price (§683): `placeOrder` copies `shop_products.currency` onto `shop_orders.currency` in the order's own insert, read under the same locks as the price, so a product moved from euro to lei leaves every order already placed in euro, its total in euro in the zone, the list, the CSV (a column «Monedă» / "Currency" after the unit price, the unit price and the total written in the order's currency) and the emails («Comanda nr. 12: Tricou — M × 2 — 60,50 €»). A product's currency may change after orders exist — nothing is recomputed. The audit rows of a product carry its currency, never its price.

**Schema.** `shop_products.currency` and `shop_orders.currency`, `text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RON'` under a CHECK (`currency IN ('RON','EUR')`), one expand-only migration (`0134_shop_price_currency`); every existing row is in lei, which is what it was. `price_bani` and `unit_price_bani` keep their names and become "the price in the minor unit of `currency`": bani for RON, cents for EUR — the schema comments say so.

**Refused.** A conversion or an exchange rate: the club collects outside the site and a price is a number the member reads, never a sum the platform charges (§683); a rate would be a second price nobody set. A currency per variant: one product, one price, one currency — a product that costs differently is two products. Renaming `price_bani` to `price_minor`: a contract change (AGENTS.md §7.6) for a column no screen names. A custom input with a currency mask: a native select and the same box, no client island, no dependency.

**Amends §683**: «a price in lei kept as integer bani» and «the currency is the club's, never converted» become «a price in lei or in euro, kept as an integer in that currency's minor unit, shown as such, never converted». `SETUP.md` §43 step 3 names the select.
changelogLine: - **A shop price in lei or in euro** — «Moneda» beside the price in the editor; the zone, the orders, the CSV (a currency column) and the emails show each price in its own currency, never converted, and an order keeps the currency it was placed in. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A product's price carries a currency, lei or euro, chosen per product and shown as such in the members' zone, the editor, the orders list, the CSV (a currency column after the unit price) and the three emails, never converted; an order copies the product's currency with its unit price in its own transaction and keeps it when the product's currency changes; a product posted without a currency is in lei and one outside the two is refused naming the box (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
